primary_task: Interview the user on quality dimensions, write CONSTRAINTS.md with thresholds, add check scripts and a pointer in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md for the project.

requirements.name: ask_user / live user
requirements.evidence: The interview needs a live user. **Don't run it in non-interactive contexts**
requirements.basis: ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation

requirements.name: write/edit files
requirements.evidence: One file at the repo root. ... `CONSTRAINTS.md`

requirements.name: mypy / pytest-cov / semgrep (pip, pipx)
requirements.evidence: Picking a dimension means installing something. ... `pip install mypy`, `pipx install semgrep`
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)

requirements.name: npm tools (lighthouse, axe, size-limit, stryker, dependency-cruiser)
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, ...)

requirements.name: gitleaks, osv-scanner (brew)
requirements.basis: bash: ... GitHub release downloads (brew itself is not listed; release binaries are obtainable)

requirements.name: running URL / preview deploy for Lighthouse and axe
requirements.evidence: Lighthouse and axe need a URL. ... If the project has no URL to hit ... say so and drop the dimension
requirements.basis: bash: start and stop local servers inside the session; a browser for Lighthouse is not stated

notes: All per-dimension tools depend on the user's answers, so none is hard. A project repo in the working directory is assumed (not stated). Lighthouse needs a browser (unknown); the document lets that dimension be dropped.
